dish: sandwiches on house bread (the 'Graubünden sand') and seasonal-fruit cakes
n: Graubünden, Hirafu (おやつとサンドイッチのお店 グラウビュンデン)
address: Niseko Hirafu 5-jō 4-chōme 2-6, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A sweets-and-sandwich café in Hirafu village known for its house sandwiches and seasonal-fruit cakes; listed in Kutchan's official town specialty catalogue.

dish: omakase of fish bought daily from nearby bays (hairy crab, tuna belly, ankimo)
address: Fujimi 65, Niseko-chō, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Counter sushi in Niseko town where chef Yoshioka buys from the local bays each morning — the omakase runs from sashimi to hairy crab and chawanmushi; dinner only, booking essential.
